info.title: Bazaura.pk API
info.description: Backend for the Bazaura.pk mobile app and website. All orders are Cash on Delivery.

post.summary: Send a login code by SMS
Verify code and log in / sign up
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens

get.summary: List, filter, search and sort products
Product page data (by slug or id)

post.summary: Write a review (one per customer per product)

post.description: The cart itself lives on the device. Send its items here to get live prices, stock problems, voucher discount, delivery options and the exact total the order will charge.

post.summary: Cancel an order before it is packed
Ask Bazaura to arrange an item or send a gift
Accept the quote; creates a Cash on Delivery order

get.summary: Everything the home screen needs in one call
All public product and category URLs (for Next.js sitemap.xml)

post.summary: Get a URL to upload an image

parameters.name: lowStock

schema.description: Products with any variant at 5 or fewer units
schema.title: Lowstock

parameters.description: Products with any variant at 5 or fewer units

delete.summary: Archive a product (hidden from the store; order history is kept)

patch.description: Staff may update stock; everything else is the same for admins.

patch.summary: Move an order forward (PLACED → CONFIRMED → PACKED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED) or cancel it

AddressSnapshot.title: AddressSnapshot
AddressSnapshot.description: Address frozen onto an order or custom request.

CartIssue.title: CartIssue
CartIssue.description: A problem the customer must resolve before checkout (shown in the cart UI).

city.title: City
city.description: Delivery city; needed to check express eligibility

status.description: Use IN_REVIEW or UNAVAILABLE; quoting has its own endpoint

DeliveryAddressIn.title: DeliveryAddressIn
DeliveryAddressIn.description: Inline address. For gifts this is the recipient's address.

OrderCreate.title: OrderCreate
OrderCreate.description:
Prices are never accepted from the client — the server recalculates
everything from the database. Payment is Cash on Delivery.

fullName.title: Fullname
fullName.description: Used only when creating a new account

ProductCard.title: ProductCard
ProductCard.description: Compact product used in listings, carousels and the wishlist.

unitPrice.title: Unitprice
unitPrice.description: Price of one item (PKR); multiplied by the requested quantity

extraFee.title: Extrafee
extraFee.description: Defaults to the gift wrap fee when requested

SeoMeta.title: SeoMeta
SeoMeta.description: Everything the Next.js site needs for <head> tags and JSON-LD.

StorefrontConfig.title: StorefrontConfig
StorefrontConfig.description:
Business settings the apps display (e.g. "Delivery in 3 hours").
Frontends must read these instead of hard-coding them.
